---
title: "wdm documentation"
subtitle: "Weight-dynamics modeling: an energy-balance state-space model of body weight, a joint Kalman filter that learns one person's metabolism from a scale and a food log, and a model-predictive controller that turns the estimate into a daily calorie and macronutrient prescription."
---

`wdm` is a Python package (JAX, Equinox, Diffrax) with a command-line tool of the same name. The subject weighs in each morning and logs food as the day goes; once a day `wdm` re-estimates the state and replans what to eat next. The [presentation](../weight-dynamics.html) tells the story in slides; these pages are the manual.

::: {.callout-note}
## The code is private
The package lives in a private repository. These pages document it in full, and the [API reference](reference/index.qmd) is generated from its docstrings, but installing it and running the walkthrough's scripts require access to that repository.
:::

[The pieces](../index.qmd#the-pieces) summarizes the model, the two estimation phases, and the controller.

## Where to start

- **Use it:** [Getting started](getting-started.md) installs it and sets up the files; [The daily routine](daily-routine.md) is the whole day-to-day obligation (two commands); [Exercise energy](exercise.md) estimates `exercise_kcal` for lifters.
- **Look something up:** [Commands](commands.md) lists every command and option; [The observations file](data.md) and [The subject file](configuration.md) define every column and setting; [Reading the output](reading-output.md) explains each number the tool prints, what to expect when, and what to do when something looks wrong.
- **Understand the method:** [the model](theory/model.md), [estimation](theory/estimation.md), [control](theory/control.md), their [limitations](theory/limitations.md), and the [notation](theory/notation.md).
- **Learn the code:** the [walkthrough](walkthrough/index.qmd) runs the package one layer at a time on synthetic data with known truth.
- **Use it from Python:** the [API reference](reference/index.qmd); [Development](development.md) covers the layout, the tests, and regenerating the figures and numbers.

::: {.callout-warning}
## Not medical advice
This is a modeling exercise built on population-level physiology and fitted to one person's self-reported data. Its estimates come with honest, often wide, intervals, and its safety limits are general guidance, not anything specific to any one person. Talk to a doctor or a registered dietitian before acting on an aggressive plan.
:::
